codegen_and_trace.compiler: same AMD Clang 22 gfx1100 decode profile
codegen_and_trace.trace: After non-profiled exact-key prebuild, cache-only rocprofv3 must name the distinct candidate at grid/local 256/256, allocated VGPR<=16, LDS1024, scratch0, plausible duration, exact finite outputs, clean lifecycle, and no compiler under profiling.

commit_boundaries: Commit this design before repository implementation.
Commit the separately registered primitive after RED/GREEN, CPU, all-47-layer, codegen, repeated endpoint, and cache-only trace gates.
Commit a false/default-off runtime owner only after primitive admission and full-state correctness.
Commit retained default or rejection immediately after frozen clean/category adjudication.
correctness: Synthetic hidden17/3072 random, signed-zero/subnormal/finite-edge, BF16 first-boundary-sensitive, and adversarial norm-weight/epsilon cases preserve both hidden and norm bytes versus retained D9 and the registered unfused chain.
Independent CPU reference must pass KL<=0.05 and top-1>=90%; candidate/control outputs remain BF16-bit exact.

All 47 actual sparse-layer hidden and norm outputs must be byte exact. Repeat the frozen layers1/47 50-warmup/15-counterbalanced/1000-launch event+wall gate once and require all four medians positive.
primitive_red_green: Add one distinct HIP body/C export, strict wrapper/package export, and exact four-axis key without modifying the retained D9 body/key/default.
Prove the candidate body is mechanically the retained body plus only the frozen reduction replacement; require non-null pointers, rows=1, positive features, and local256 before launch.
Register only on hip_gfx1100 and prove gfx1151/cuda/cpu absence. Keep both retained D9 and registered add+add+RMSNorm fallbacks callable.
Primitive admission adds no backend capability, session/runner/CLI selector, allocation, workspace, sidecar, dispatch, or default change.
promotion: Freeze two counterbalanced process orders at short/512/1K/3968. Every order must improve the complete D9 family and kernel sum, keep span<=+0.5%, child>=-0.5%, and preserve exact topology/resources/IDs/lifecycle/no-compiler. Stop on first failure; no third order or pooled waiver.

Only after all contexts pass, run both complete 18-prompt natural-completion category orders at h16/h32. Require aggregate and every train/heldout category decode positive, E2E>=-0.5%, prefill>=-0.5%, TTFT<=+0.5%, exact IDs/state/lifecycle, and no prompt-conditioned behavior.
Promote only if every gate passes; otherwise remove runtime ownership while retaining the exact separately registered diagnostic primitive.
runtime_correctness: Add a separate false/default-off gfx1100 capability and explicit session/CLI opt-in only after primitive admission; no-argument default stays retained D9.

Shared-weight bulk prefill, all 48 hidden and 47 routed boundaries, 16 transitions, active K/V and every KVLiveSpans field, reset/re-prefill, ownership, lifecycle, KL0, and top-1 100% must match retained D9.

Cache-only two-transition tracing must show exactly 47 candidate calls/token, zero retained D9 decode calls, unchanged 678 model kernels/token, exact IDs/resources/lifecycle, and no compiler; rows/prefill/gfx1151/key-miss/explicit-disable must retain controls.

codegen.interpretation: The exact wave-0 tree removes seven barriers and 41 static instructions while keeping fixed LDS1024, private/spills0, SGPR24, and the same allocated-VGPR16 class expected from logical VGPR13->14. Repository admission must reproduce these ceilings and prove allocated resources under cache-only rocprof.

decision.next_action: Commit design only, then admit the primitive under RED/GREEN before any runtime owner.

lineage.result: Only already-catalogued unrelated external drift; the selected D9 body is in-tree and unchanged.

stride32: those two values are added
stride16/8/4/2/1: wave32 shuffle-down additions preserve the baseline lane tree

per-thread square accumulation, rsqrt/divide/epsilon, norm multiply association
thread/block geometry, LDS capacity, runtime allocation or producer ownership
retained D9 body/key or registered add+add+RMSNorm fallback
unchanged_boundaries: hidden_out is stored before RMS accumulation and reloaded for normalization
each thread accumulates hidden[idx]^2 for idx=tid,tid+256,... in the same order

modeled_ceiling.interpretation: Planning ceiling only; endpoint launch medians are not full-model throughput, and the small modeled gain cannot close Vulkan alone.
modeled_ceiling.method: Apply only the smallest actual endpoint event-or-wall ratio to the immutable retained 47-call D9 family; leave every other kernel and host interval unchanged.

standalone Q6 and mixed-Q6 metadata/local32 premises

residual_ranking.interpretation: The next independent exact surface is the already-retained D9 composite's internal RMS reduction, not another launch-owner composition. The current body still uses a full 256-thread LDS tree and nine barriers in every one of 47 calls.
residual_ranking.method: Re-rank all 28 stable token windows from the two immutable retained short control roots used by the gated-single-page adjudication after restoring runtime ownership to canonical.

rollup.reason: design selection only; no repository primitive, runtime owner, default, or full-model throughput measurement

selection.description: Keep both BF16 add boundaries, hidden store, per-thread hidden-square accumulation, rsqrt, norm multiply order, outputs, one-block ownership, and 1 KiB LDS. After all 256 partials are published, wave 0 loads the eight lane-aligned wave values and reproduces the exact stride-128/64/32 tree, then reproduces stride-16/8/4/2/1 with five wave32 shuffles before publishing the identical scalar.
